description:
Welcome to the official Spawn to Apex channel!

Trace nature's most extreme life cycles from microscopic spawn to final metamorphosis.
Clear, visual, research-backed 2D hand-drawn explainers crafted for Curious adults, biology lovers, and viewers hooked on bizarre chronological life-cycle transformations.

Core topics: Extreme animal & insect metamorphosis, deep-sea life cycles & parasite survival chronicles.
